subject: reasoning
question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are coloured Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Black, White. Select the colour that will be on the face opposite to the one coloured Blue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9ad696b6ca83efcaa9b697aaff5678521a067e72d050a6b6290b5d87b28ed86.png]
solution:
Given : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9ad696b6ca83efcaa9b697aaff5678521a067e72d050a6b6290b5d87b28ed86.png] 

The six colors are Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Black, White

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de541ab02fa6d2ee022cb6bd169591144ac42aed277ae279a13a0345289aa6f4.png] 

Both black and yellow are common in both the dices. when we move clockwise then **blue is opposite to white** because yellow, red and black are adjacent to blue so they can't be opposite to blue

Hence,** white** is the correct answer.
